_swift_adaptations: Pod Axiom 1/4 deviation registered truthfully: SwiftPM forces tests into a separate Tests/<Pod>Tests/ directory and cannot place them with the pod; pod-lint-swift.sh enforces the equivalent 'every pod has a same-named non-empty test directory'
Pod Axiom 3 is compiler-enforced: each pod = a separate SwiftPM library target, public symbols are the contract surface (Contract.swift), the rest internal

FileManager/NSWorkspace are the controlled physical plant, not global configuration, so direct use inside a pod does not violate Axiom 2; what is banned is UserDefaults.standard/global mutable singletons
